messages:
maya: Heads-up — saw ~12% p50 regression on AWQ INT8 weight-only load in staging after last packer scheduler tweak. profiler attached as text paste.

lucas: Which workload? chatty-short or long-context?

maya: chatty-short (avg seq 128). Also reproduced locally with bench harness. KV cache hit rate dropped from 0.92 -> 0.83 on the failing runs.

zhen: interesting — that smells like packing induced eviction or a different batching pattern. any change to group_size or pack alignment?

maya: We changed the packer scheduling heuristic: prefer_serial_for_small_batches=true (rolled two days ago). config diff: ```
- packer.parallel_threshold = 2
+ packer.parallel_threshold = 999  # effectively disable parallel
```
Repro steps: `./bench --model pythia-6b-awq --quant awq-int8 --group-size 32 --seq 128 --reps 500`
Profiler snippet: ```
[prof] total tokens: 1.2M
[prof] kernel select: awq_gemm_int8 65% samples
[prof] packer.serialize_ms: 5.4 -> 12.6 (+7.2)
[prof] kvcache.lookup_ms: 0.8 -> 1.5
[prof] batching.mean_size: 1.4 -> 1.1
```

lucas: packing serialize doubling is huge. Could be single-thread path for pack/unpack. Did the change flip to single-thread on slab-frag cases?

maya: yes, scheduler now pins to serial if slab_frag_ratio > 0.06 (we thought it reduced contention). For chatty workloads slab_frag sits ~0.07 so it tripped.

zhen: group_size 32 is borderline — parallel pack benefits amortize overhead when group_size >= 16 but serial path wins for tiny microbatches. With batching.mean_size falling it likely triggers the serial code which can't hide the AWQ unpack overhead.

carla: Can you attach a minimal repro script? I can try adjusting the heuristic to check pending_queue length before forcing serial. quick patch suggestion: ```
if (slab_frag > 0.06 && pending_queue <= 1) {
  // keep parallel; serial only when many pending to avoid jitter
} else {
  // existing heuristic
}
```
Would also add a telemetry flag to record "forced_serial_reason" for triage.

maya: repro: `python perf_repro.py --model pythia-6b-awq --group 32 --seq 128 --q awq-int8 --threads 8` — run it a few times, p50 regression shows in the first 10 mins. Pushed logs to gcs at gs://redwood-perf/3511112222/logs.txt

lucas: I'll run bisect: revert the packer.change commit and re-run the bench. If it goes away we have strong signal.

perf-bot: deploy/canary started for patch packer-schedule-fix (sha: a1b2c3). :rocket:

zhen: if bisect confirms, we should also add a guard in runtime kernel chooser: prefer packing-parallel when quant backend == awq-int8 and group_size >= 32 and batching.mean_size >= 1.2 — AWQ kernels are sensitive to unpack contended latency.

carla: agree. Also add a quick e2e perf test to catch p50 regressions for chatty-short profile. maybe a 5m smoke bench in CI that checks p50 within 5% of baseline.

maya: created a follow-up issue and linked the logs: https://redwood.internal/issue/PRF-4312 — tagging for rollout plan. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
